definition: The Regulus Grammar Compiler is a software system for compiling unification grammars into grammars for speech recognition systems.
details: The Regulus Grammar Compiler is a software system for compiling unification grammars into grammars for speech recognition systems.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is Regulus Grammar Compiler.
